name: microring
description: 2D microring resonator side-coupled to a straight bus waveguide, out-of-plane E (Ez; TM in Meep's 2D naming). Effective-index model of a 220 nm SOI TE slab: core n=2.83, SiO2 cladding n=1.444, as in the Meep ring tutorials.

ring.note: Ring centre on an Ez node. 5.0/0.024 and 4.5/0.024 are not integers, so no Ez node lies exactly on either circle; TorchFDTD counts boundary nodes as material and Meep does not, and the scripts record the smallest node-to-circle distance.

bus.note: Bus centre on an Ez node; 0.5/0.024 = 20.83 cells, so both edges fall between nodes and both solvers rasterise the same 21 rows.
bus.gap_note: Chosen from a TorchFDTD ring-down sweep at this fixture (loaded Q from the energy decay of a point probe in the ring, 4 ps development runs made before the comparison): gap 0.15 um gives Q about 1e4 and 0.19 um above 1e5 (the 5 um ring has no measurable bend loss at this contrast, so the loaded Q is set by the coupler alone); 0.11 um gives 3500, 0.07 um 1500 (20 nm mesh); 0.054 um gives 950 and 0.03 um 610 (24 nm mesh). 0.054 um is the largest lattice-compatible gap whose loaded Q lies in the declared 500-2000 window and whose amplitude e-fold time Q*lambda/(pi*c) = 1.6 ps fits three times into the 5 ps run.

source.waveform: amplitude*exp(-0.5*((t-4*sigma)/sigma)^2)*sin(2*pi*f0*t), sigma=pulse_cycles/f0, f0=c/wavelength; additive (soft) Ez current on the Ez node column x_cell over the 63 rows [61,124) of the line |y-center_y|<=width/2, whose ends lie on nodes: Meep's restriction of such a line gives weight 1 on rows 62..122 and 0.5 on rows 61 and 123 (checked from the field after one step); TorchFDTD reproduces this with one uniform plane source over rows 62..122 plus two point sources of amplitude 0.5 on rows 61 and 123.
source.injection_note: TorchFDTD adds amplitude*waveform to Ez at each source node after its E update; Meep adds a current J, i.e. E += -dt*J/eps, so the Meep script scales J by the node permittivity (amp_func) to give the same E increment on the 21 core rows and the 42 cladding rows. The overall amplitude and time-step conventions still differ and cancel in the ratio T.

monitors.note: x-normal flux planes across the bus at the Ez node columns in_x_cell/out_x_cell; 83 Ez rows, the plane ends fall between nodes.

cell_index_note: cells are half-open [start, stop) indices into the Ez node lattice x_i = i*dx - size_x/2, y_j = j*dx - size_y/2
normalisation: T(lambda) = flux_out(ring run) / flux_out(straight-bus run) of the same solver; the in monitor is recorded for reference.
sampling: staircase at the Yee Ez nodes (TorchFDTD material_sampling='yee', Meep eps_averaging=False); no symmetry, no subpixel.
run_time_note: 5 ps = 3.2 amplitude e-fold times of the Q = 950 resonance (field residual 4 percent at the end of the window); 89219 steps is the longest run below TorchFDTD's 100000-step limit at this mesh.
